fields.label: Purpose of the trip
options: C-09 - Cultural, scientific, educational, sport activities

notices: To apply for a visa, you need to register - create your account to enter your personal account, where you can fill in a visa application form, register it for review and monitor the status of visa application.

The visa application form is submitted no later than one working day (in case of urgent e-Visa processing), or three working days (in case of general e-Visa processing) before the start of the planned trip.
Citizens of the selected country are not issued an e-Visa for this purpose of the trip
